name: Safari
why: Safari is my main browser at home and has been pretty much since its inception. Periodically I go off and use Firefox

quotes.quote: Safari is my main browser at home and has been pretty much since its inception. Periodically I go off and use Firefox
quotes.excerpt: Safari is my main browser at home and has been pretty much since its inception. Periodically I go off and use Firefox, Arch, and other such things, but I always come back to Safari. It just gets out of my way, while integrating a few quality of life features that normally end up as extensions in other browsers. My big gripe with Safari is the extensions being moved to the App Store. This creates a lot of unnecessary
quotes.story: Ask HN: What browser do you use?

quotes.excerpt: Same here, I love it. I've also caught quite a few Safari only bugs because I was "that one dev on the team who uses Safari" - everyone needs a Safari dev on their team.
quotes.context: the Safari dev on the team
quotes.story: Ask HN: What browser do you use?

quotes.excerpt: Firefox or Safari for Browser, and just install the apps you need (you should know your must-have)
